pcs.pc_description: develop age-appropriate daily plans that consider children's individual needs, interests, and developmental stages.
prepare a stimulating environment with age- appropriate resources and activities.
ensure the environment is safe and hazard- free for all age groups.

identify children who may need additional support or intervention.
communicate observations and assessments effectively with parents/guardians and relevant professionals.
use assessment information to plan and modify activities to meet children's individual needs.
develop positive and trusting relationships with all children in the creche.
foster communication and collaboration with parents/guardians to ensure continuity of care.
create a sense of belonging and security for each child within the crèche setting.
work effectively with other staff members to create a supportive and consistent environment for children.
respect and celebrate children's cultural backgrounds and family values.
maintain professional boundaries and confidentiality in all interactions.
stay up-to-date on best practices in early childhood development and care.
participate in ongoing professional development opportunities to enhance knowledge and skills.
reflect on practice and identify areas for personal and professional growth.
contribute to a positive and collaborative work environment.
advocate for the well-being and best interests of children in the creche setting.
